ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast binary distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric white central fields on both lobes bounded by thick black peripheral margins; a distinct vertical black linear intrusion bisecting the mid-section of the left lobe; dense black mottling localized at the medial-ventral base of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes of 5-12 pixels; serrations are more jagged and clustered on the lateral 1/3 of both lobes compared to the smoother inner margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a parabolic curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-8 pixels in diameter) concentrated within the black-pigmented distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel vertical black linear marks on the central-left lobe; several fine-line diagonal white abrasions crossing the pigmented margin of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged edge loss on the distal tip of the left lobe; vertical rake marks consisting of four parallel dark linear disruptions on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark 'hook-shaped' pigment cluster located within the upper-distal white field of the right lobe.
